description: Optimize the cubic Fm-3m bulk structure of titanium nitride.
user_prompt: Optimize the cubic (Fm-3m) bulk structure of titanium nitride (TiN). Report the final converged energy and lattice constant.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: Rock-salt TiN conventional cubic bulk cell with space group Fm-3m; TiN formula unit is one Ti and one N atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-492 GGA final energy per atom (-9.8314 eV/atom) multiplied by two atoms per TiN formula unit. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constant is left as a diagnostic because the accepted energy is tied to MP PAW/PBE conventions. TiN is metallic in this MP calculation and uses Ti_pv/N PAW potentials; the +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, and smearing differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
